search_window.basis: Latest previously verified completed_at from ops/watch-ledger. Screened source publication and event dates, not only crawler dates.

coverage_notes.purpose: Supplementary bounded high-value recall watch only; production nationwide collection remains authoritative.
target_classes: Closure, fire or disaster loss of a community's only, last, sole or full-service grocery
Storm, flood, fire, outage or building damage cancellation/suspension of emergency food distributions
Abrupt food pantry or food-bank service closure or major access reduction
Official SNAP, WIC or food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences
bounded_query_context: "only grocery store" fire OR closure town November 1 2026
"sole grocery store" burned OR shuttered November 2026
"food distribution" canceled due to storm OR flooding OR power outage November 1 2026
"emergency food" distribution suspended storm fire power Sunday November 1 2026
"food pantry" "temporarily closed" fire OR flood OR power November 2026
coverage_notes.observation: No source dated within the observation interval independently established a qualifying new U.S. food-access disruption. Results surfaced historical grocery-store closures, earlier storm recovery notices and unrelated documents, but no verified same-hour change in grocery, emergency distribution, pantry, SNAP, WIC or EBT access.

excluded_examples.title: Town of Spencer recovering after losing only grocery store in fire
excluded_examples.reason: Qualifying incident class, but September 14 report predates current hour by weeks.

excluded_examples.title: What Kauaʻi County residents, visitors need to know Oct. 29 about Hurricane Lowell recovery
excluded_examples.reason: Older broad disaster-resource update, not a newly announced emergency food-distribution cancellation in this window.

excluded_examples.title: Avondale's only grocery store announces closing after just over 1 year
excluded_examples.reason: Prior announcement, not verified as new in this hour.

duplicate_screen.method: Fetched the latest two committed watch-ledger files and screened results against prior historical/duplicate candidates, including the already-known Provo, Utah closure.

coverage_notes.limitations: Twelve time-limited targeted web searches are non-exhaustive. Same-hour local agency notices may not yet be indexed. No finding does not establish that no incident exists nationwide.
coverage_notes.production_authority: No approval, public publication, production collector alteration, schedule change or disabling.
